title: CLOUT: Industry Simulator by MoonLightNia
author: cloutindustry
selftext:
⬆️⬆️

Link to my game above

Basically I had a vision for this game industry simulator. And currently in the works of creating it. A world where you can widely explore diffferent branches in the industry.

It’s made with Claude AI specifically Opus 4.8 and I’m working really hard to bring the vision to life! Check out the game and give your critiques.

Im really early in stages...i wanna add lots like more chohesive Pixel designs. And obviously way deeper job cycles..and things you can do but i really want some feedback on just the gameplay so far. I didn't wanna go the only the bitlift route and what not..I want players to commit to their in game lifes and whatever career they decide for the cycle and what not. 

ANYWAY! This is my first time reacting a app like this so...just critiques would be awesome.
